title: The Guilty
content: The Guilty, directed by Gustav Möller, is a gripping Danish thriller that takes place in real-time over the course of a single evening. The film centers on Asger Holm, a police officer working the emergency dispatch desk. When he receives a call from a kidnapped woman, he is thrust into a high-stakes situation where every decision could mean the difference between life and death. As the story unfolds, Asger's own troubled past begins to intertwine with the case, creating a tense and emotionally charged atmosphere. The Guilty is a taut, edge-of-your-seat thriller that proves that sometimes the most compelling stories can unfold in the most confined spaces.
